card.name: And after opioid names in combination tablets
card.fires_on: The word 'and' right after an opioid name such as oxycodone or hydrocodone, in names of combination tablets like oxycodone and acetaminophen. Also the start of 'chlor' in chloramphenicol and 'Hydro' in a hydrocodone product name.

modes.label: And in combination names
modes.description: The word 'and' joining an opioid to its partner drug in a tablet name.
modes.example: cer is discontinued, consider oxycodone<< and>> acetaminophen tablets dosage reduction and

modes.label: Start of chlor- or Hydro- names
modes.description: The first piece of a long drug name such as chloramphenicol or hydrocodone.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the word 'generic' and away from words like medication and medicine.
card.plain: It fires on the 'and' inside names of combination painkiller tablets, such as oxycodone and acetaminophen.
